findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure cryptographic operations
 * @description Using weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms can lead to security vulnerabilities
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-crypto
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Weak hash functions
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
  // Insecure random
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["randint", "randrange", "choice", "shuffle"]).getACall() or
  // Deprecated crypto
  call = API::moduleImport("Crypto").getMember(["ARC4", "DES", "MD2", "MD4"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("cryptography").getMember(["hazmat", "primitives"]).getMember(["ciphers", "hashes"]).getMember(["ARC4", "DES", "MD5", "SHA1"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially insecure cryptographic operation that should be reviewed."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure cryptographic operations using weak algorithms
